summary: The vigabatrin row is broadly correct for identity, indications, FDA approval year, mechanism, dosing, QT, REMS/boxed-warning content, and most RCT outcomes. It needs updates for FDA black-box source compliance, CYP2C9 induction, half-life, formulations, adverse-event percentages, trusted source names, PubMed alias coverage, and likely addition of French1996/PMID 8559421 with an RR50 differential of 18%.
